hook: Mozilla: why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS
hookText: Mozilla: why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

beats.say: Mozilla says that nearly three years after Apple allowed alternative browser engines in the EU, and almost a year after Japan.
As one example, Mozilla says it could not simply update the existing Firefox app to use Gecko.
Firefox daily use on iOS has doubled since the DMA browser choice screen, but Mozilla calls Apple's open door "more like a trap door" and says it will keep pushing.
